statement.p: Imagine making up a number with the following pattern. After the decimal point, write the natural numbers 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, etc. The decimal digits will extend forever with this pattern: 0.12345\ldots\text{.}

Is the number a rational number or an irrational number?
?
rational
irrational

solution.p: The number is irrational. The decimal will never end and it will never repeat.
